name: phil/usage-meter
description: Quotas that refuse an action before it exceeds its limit: counters per subject over calendar months, billing periods or rolling windows, idempotent increments.

suggest.doctrine/dbal: To keep the counters in a database with DbalUsageStore
suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the counter tables to the schema the ORM generates, with UsageSchemaListener
suggest.phil/commerce-subscription-bundle: To read limits from the features of a subscriber's offers, with FeatureLimits::fromSubscriptions()
